cards.text: Meet the boy Samuel. He serves the LORD under Eli, the priest (1 Samuel 1:9). And friend, there's something strange about these days in Israel.

cards.question: What's strange about those days in Israel?

answers.text: The word of the LORD is rare
No rain has fallen in years
The lamp of God stays dark

cards.text: Rare, friend. Like a phone that hasn't buzzed in MONTHS. And Eli, whose eyesight has grown so dim he can't see, is lying in his room.

cards.question: And where is the boy Samuel lying down?

answers.text: In the temple where the ark of God is
In his parents' house in Ramah
Out in the hills with the flocks

cards.text: The lamp of God hasn't gone out yet. Then the LORD calls to Samuel, and the boy answers, "Here I am."

cards.question: True or false: Samuel thinks Eli is the one calling him.

cards.text: He RUNS to Eli. No snooze button, no stretching, just a boy sprinting in the dark: "Here I am, for you have called me."

cards.question: Eli says he didn't call, and he tells Samuel to go back and ___.

cards.text: You ever get back in bed and get JUST comfy? Yeah. Once again the LORD calls, "Samuel!"

cards.question: True or false: The second time, Samuel stays in bed to see if he hears his name again.

cards.text: Up again, straight to Eli: "Here I am, for you have called me." Eli calls him my son, says he didn't call, and sends him back to lie down, and the boy is now oh-for-two on figuring out who's calling.

cards.question: Why doesn't Samuel recognize that it's the LORD calling him?

answers.text: He did not yet know the LORD
Eli had told him to ignore voices
He thought the LORD only called priests

cards.text: For the third time the LORD calls, and for the third time Samuel shows up at Eli's side: "Here I am, for you have called me." Three calls in one night? I spent YEARS in a junk drawer and nobody called me ONCE.

cards.question: True or false: This time, Eli realizes it's the LORD calling the boy.
Eli sends Samuel back to lie down. If the voice calls again, what does Eli tell Samuel to say?

answers.text: Ask the LORD to speak because he's listening
Ask the voice to tell him who it is
Ask the voice to come back in the morning

cards.text: So Samuel goes and lies down in his place. Then the LORD comes and stands there, calling as before, "Samuel! Samuel!"

cards.question: This time, no running. Samuel tells the LORD to ___ because he's listening.

cards.text: The LORD has a listener now. And He says, "I am about to do something in Israel at which the ears of all who hear it will tingle."

cards.question: On that day, the LORD says, He will carry out against ___ everything He has spoken about his house, from beginning to end.

cards.text: The LORD says He told Eli He would judge his house forever, for the iniquity Eli knows about. So this isn't news to Eli.

cards.question: What is the iniquity the LORD says Eli knows about?

answers.text: His sons blasphemed God and he did not restrain them
He stopped offering the yearly sacrifices at the temple
He let the lamp of God go out in the temple

cards.text: Then the LORD tells Samuel what He has sworn to the house of Eli. It's about whether this iniquity can ever be covered.

cards.question: True or false: The LORD says enough sacrifices and offerings can still atone for the iniquity of Eli's house.

cards.text: Samuel lies down until the morning, then opens the doors of the house of the LORD. Now he's holding a message about Eli, and Eli is right there.

cards.question: Samuel is ___ to tell Eli the vision.

cards.text: Then Eli calls to him, "Samuel, my son." Samuel gives the same answer he gave all night, except this time it really IS Eli calling.

cards.question: Eli asks Samuel what message the LORD gave him. What does Eli want from Samuel?

answers.text: Only the parts about his sons
A short summary for later on

cards.text: And Eli means it: "May God punish you, and ever so severely, if you hide from me anything He said to you." That's not a request, friend. That's a meeting invite with no decline button.

cards.question: True or false: Samuel softens the message and leaves out the hardest parts.
Samuel tells Eli everything. How does Eli respond to the message?

answers.text: He says let the LORD do what He sees as good
He argues that the message is not fair to him
He tells Samuel to keep the whole thing quiet

cards.text: Samuel doesn't hide a thing. And Eli answers that He is the LORD: "Let Him do what is good in His eyes."
Samuel grows, and the LORD is with him. The boy who sprinted to the wrong room three times in one night? Look at him now.

cards.question: As Samuel grows up, what happens with his words?

answers.text: The LORD lets none of them fall to the ground
Eli writes each one of them down on a scroll
The elders test each one before all of Israel

cards.question: Word gets around. All Israel from Dan to Beersheba knows Samuel is confirmed as a ___ of the LORD.
Remember how the word of the LORD was rare? True or false: After this, the LORD keeps appearing at Shiloh, revealing Himself to Samuel by His word.

cards.text: That quiet phone is BUZZING now, friend. And that's where we'll leave it for now, because this story is far from done.
